metadata.title: Hypervisor Trust

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring the integrity, isolation, and secure control of hypervisors underpinning virtualized compute platforms.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Hypervisors, virtual machine monitors, privileged virtualization control planes, and intra-host execution boundaries.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Protects the integrity and trustworthiness of hypervisors and their privileged management interfaces.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Hypervisor trust assumes a trusted physical host, firmware, and secure boot foundation.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Hypervisor trust builds upon baseline virtual machine isolation and intra-host trust assumptions.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Hypervisor integrity, privileged access risk, and virtualization trust boundary considerations as described in NIST SP 800-125.

metadata.remarks: Hypervisor Trust defines the trust properties required to ensure the hypervisor enforcing virtualization boundaries remains secure, isolated, and resistant to compromise. Because hypervisor failure compromises all hosted workloads, this pattern focuses on integrity, privileged access control, and blast-radius containment, consistent with NIST SP 800-125 guidance.

components.title: Hypervisor Integrity
components.description: Protection of hypervisor binaries, configuration, and execution state from unauthorized modification.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Privilege escalation into the hypervisor through exploitation of control-plane or low-level interfaces.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Verification of hypervisor binaries and configuration integrity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integrity protection for hypervisor code and configuration.

components.title: Hypervisor Privileged Access Control
components.description: Restriction and governance of hypervisor administrative and management access.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of elevation control mechanisms associated with privileged hypervisor functions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong identity, authorization, and auditing for hypervisor administrators.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Strong authentication for privileged hypervisor access.

components.title: Hypervisor Failure Containment
components.description: Limitation of blast radius and impact resulting from hypervisor faults or compromise.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Service disruption affecting all virtual machines on a compromised host.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Containment and isolation to prevent cascading failures across virtualized workloads.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Boundary protection limiting the impact of hypervisor compromise.
Recovery and availability controls to limit platform-wide impact.
